verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows published per-minute or per-hour transcription prices, or itemized add-on prices, that an agent could use to estimate a job's cost before submitting it. Medical Mode is described as an add-on, but no price is given for it. The community comments on volume discounts and price parity with competitors do not document any rate structure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can compute the cost of a transcription job before submitting it, because pricing is published per audio minute or hour with add-on prices itemized
